record.hypothesis: New source-selection/remux profile · P2 · Risk: Medium · PROPOSED / NOT TESTED First environment: Host FFmpeg construction plus sandbox MSE destination pilot; no live/network qualification. Related cards: R07. Proposed mechanism. Treat a requested TS program as the playback unit. If that program contains browser-compatible H.264/AAC, select and packet-copy only its streams to the known MSE packaging path instead of letting unrelated programs influence compatibility or loading extra decoders. What is new. Earlier TS cases contained one presentation, and alternate-audio cases addressed tracks within it. A program has its own stream group and identity; treating every stream in the transport as part of one requested presentation is the new problem to test.
